dossier.headline: Week of 16 November: FII buying meets oil, rupee and inflation risks
dossier.summary: Previews of the week of 16 November centre on foreign flows, after FIIs bought about ₹33,340 crore over 9–13 November, their third straight week of buying after ten weeks of selling. Nvidia's results, October inflation data, US-India trade talks and US Fed minutes are on the calendar. Analysts see foreign buying as the main support, with oil above $95, a weak rupee and possible profit booking as the risks.
why_it_matters: Foreign buying has been the main support for the market
Retail inflation of 6.09% is above the RBI's 6% upper limit
